mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO agent_message (message_id, conversation_id, role, content, sources, feedback, feedback_reason, creator, updater, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES
(#{item.messageId}, #{item.conversationId}, #{item.role}, #{item.content}, #{item.sources}, #{item.feedback}, #{item.feedbackReason}, #{item.creator}, #{item.updater}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.deleted})
mapper.select: SELECT id, message_id, conversation_id, role, content, sources, feedback, feedback_reason, creator, updater, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM agent_message WHERE conversation_id = #{param1} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_message SET content = #{content}, sources = #{sources}, feedback = #{feedback}, feedback_reason = #{feedbackReason}, updater = #{updater}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE agent_message SET deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE conversation_id = #{param1} AND deleted = 0
